blindPixelObservations: A portrait-format illustrated rules card fills the image.
The upper half contains dark blue, cyan, magenta, and black science-fiction artwork; a dark figure occupies the left and a smaller armed figure appears at lower right of the art.
A magenta-and-black framed title panel overlays the lower part of the artwork.
Below the title is one centered instruction line containing one white pictogram, followed by a centered OR divider.
A COMMAND heading and a three-line instruction occupy the next dark panel.
A white REACTION panel spans the lower middle; REACTION is printed vertically on a white tab at left, while five centered text lines appear in the panel.
The footer is black with widely spaced magenta letters.
No other non-decorative standalone pictogram is visibly established.
